saved mask comes from C5, which reloads the baseline array B (1991-12-27..2003-01-05) and target array T (2013-06-01..08-31) saved in C3 for the full 60x60 region. It computes per-cell hazen 90th-percentile pools of ±5 days around each base day-of-year, smooths them with a 31-day wrapped mean, and compares them against all 92 target days. Only thresholds for target day-of-year 153–244 are used; with smoothing (doy 138–259) and the ±5-day pools, that means baseline dates May 12–Sep 20 of each year 1992–2002."}
